description: Main window: open/save dialogs, read/write only files the user chose, and the settings store. The fs permissions carry no static scope: the dialog plugin adds each picked or saved file at runtime, and the fs plugin adds dropped paths. A dropped folder (which the app never opens) is added recursively for the rest of the session; that is the fs plugin's built-in drop rule, and turning it off would also stop dropped files from opening. window:allow-destroy closes the window after the unsaved-changes prompt.
